description: Intentionally injected data-quality issues in synthetic-dataset.json, left unfixed on purpose so the Scheduler, Chatbot, Data Analyzer, and Internal Dashboard can be tested against imperfect data. Do not silently clean these up in the dataset itself.

issues.description: last_activity is null for every row belonging to this customer, instead of a date. Simulates a customer whose usage-tracking event never landed.
issues.expected_handling: Internal Dashboard's account-health flag should treat this as an 'Unknown' health state, not silently default it into Active/Declining/Inactive.

issues.description: sj_0011 appears twice in the dataset, on two different rows with different client_id/customer_id/job_date/job_status. Simulates an ID collision bug upstream.
issues.expected_handling: Data Analyzer should detect job_id is not unique and either flag or de-duplicate explicitly, rather than double-counting job volume.

issues.description: job_status uses a legacy-style lowercase value that isn't one of the three allowed values for this dataset. Simulates status drift from an older system/import.
issues.expected_handling: Consumers should validate job_status against the allowed set and flag/reject unrecognized values rather than silently bucketing them.
